title: Reorder Bundling Opportunity
dataSources: Consumable levels (`supply:level`), parcels (`delivery:parcel`), bin collections (`bincollection:event`), gift-card balances (`giftcard:balance`).
app: Household logistics feeds — smart-scale consumable trackers, parcel/delivery tracking APIs, council bin-collection calendars, and gift-card balance logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=supply:level
| eval days_left=round(level_pct/daily_use_pct,1)
| where days_left<=14
| stats values(item) as items min(days_left) as soonest by vendor
| sort soonest
description: Highlights low-stock items that can be reordered together instead of one emergency purchase at a time.
value: Bundling planned reorders saves delivery fees, time, and the cognitive tax of constant replenishment.
implementation: Track consumable levels and preferred vendor in `index=personal`; group items that will run low in the same window.
visualization: Vendor table of low-stock items and soonest days-left value.
grandmaExplanation: It spots which household items are due for reordering together, so you can batch them instead of making panic buys.
